# AWS Codebase Documentor

Analyzes codebases and generates structured technical documentation with source-of-truth citations and architecture views, optimized for AWS workloads built with CDK, CloudFormation, and Terraform.

## Install

| Host | How |
|---|---|
| Claude Code | `/plugin marketplace add talkops-ai/devops-plugins`, then `/plugin install aws-codebase-documentor@talkops-devops-plugins` |
| Codex | `codex plugin marketplace add talkops-ai/devops-plugins`, then install from the Plugins Directory; for the agent persona, copy [`codex/agents/aws-codebase-documentor.toml`](./codex/agents/aws-codebase-documentor.toml) to `~/.codex/agents/` |
| Other Agent Plugins hosts | Load this directory; [`plugin.json`](./plugin.json), `skills/`, and [`mcp.json`](./mcp.json) follow the portable [Agent Plugins](https://agent-plugins.org) format |

## Agent

This is an **agent plugin**: every skill, command, hook, and MCP server below is bound to the [`aws-codebase-documentor`](./agents/aws-codebase-documentor.md) agent, which the host runtime spawns as a dynamic sub-agent.

- Claude Code: `@agent-aws-codebase-documentor:aws-codebase-documentor` or let Claude delegate based on the agent description
- Headless: `claude --agent aws-codebase-documentor:aws-codebase-documentor`
- Codex: install the custom agent above, then ask Codex to spawn `aws-codebase-documentor`. Codex plugins can't bundle agents, so without it the skills and MCP servers attach to the main agent.

## MCP servers

Declared in [`.mcp.json`](./.mcp.json) (Claude Code) and [`mcp.json`](./mcp.json) (portable). In Claude Code they are bound to the agent through its `tools:` allowlist.

| Server | Transport | Launch | Claude Code tool pattern | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `awsknowledge` | http | `https://knowledge-mcp.global.api.aws` | `mcp__plugin_aws-codebase-documentor_awsknowledge__*` |  |
| `awsiac` | stdio | `uvx awslabs.aws-iac-mcp-server@latest` | `mcp__plugin_aws-codebase-documentor_awsiac__*` |  |

AWS credentials are inherited from the host environment (`AWS_PROFILE`, SSO, or instance role). In Claude Code `AWS_REGION` defaults to `us-east-1` when unset; the portable `mcp.json` can't express that default, so set `AWS_REGION` in your environment on other hosts. Codex starts MCP servers with a minimal environment: if a server can't see your profile, set `AWS_PROFILE`/`AWS_REGION` for it in `~/.codex/config.toml`.
